description: Mesheal fast benchmark set: Thingi10K files whose Fix All run took under 3 seconds when they were added. The list is fixed: a file stays even if a later Fix All takes longer. New files are added only after a timed run under 3 seconds. Each file's FixSTL results are kept from the spec it came from.

selection.rule: Mesheal Fix All under 3 seconds (wall clock, Release build) when added

sources.thingi10k-v1.5.0: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Thingi10K/Thingi10K/resolve/v1.5.0/metadata (files labelled broken or healthy by Mesheal's own check; no FixSTL results)

definitions.defective: input fails at least one strict-solid check
definitions.solid: output is closed, edge- and vertex-manifold, consistently wound, free of self-intersections, duplicate and zero-area faces, with outward shells
definitions.shapeKept: same shell count, surface area within 5 %, sampled two-way distance <= 5 % of the bounding-box diagonal
definitions.crossCheckSolid: trimesh watertight and winding-consistent, and MeshLab finds no self-intersecting faces
definitions.repaired: defective input, solid output, shape kept
definitions.broken: healthy input, output not solid or shape not kept
